entities.summary: Anna Kalata is a Polish politician, celebrity and occasional actress. She was a member of the populist Samoobrona party. In Jarosław Kaczyński's cabinet she was the minister of labour and social policy. She participated in the 12th season of Taniec z Gwiazdami. After losing 38 kilograms (84 lb) she appeared on the cover of Shape magazine.
